🍪 Biscuit Release Note

💪🏻Improvements
- Windows installers and app files now use SSL.com code signing. Both 32-bit and 64-bit Windows builds remain available in the same installer.
- If you are on an older Windows version of Biscuit and automatic update fails, install Biscuit 2.2.7 once, then check for updates again.
